state_of_c_star_at_m6.what_is_open: sharpness only: attainment of m*delta_square in the balanced complement

why_the_counterexample_lives_where_it_do: The witness has S={0,4,5}, T={1,2,3}, m=6 even, T = complement(S), |S|=|T|=3: exactly the balanced complement. The empirical regularity 'the winning face has T = S^c', observed independently at m=4 and m=6 by the face-enumeration LP, is therefore FORCED, not luck. Everywhere else the (m-1) bound is a theorem, so no counterexample can exist there. Four instruments kept rediscovering that one geometry because it is the only one available.
